summary: Backend-only regression + 17 new tests for Table-Gnostic iteration 4 (player primer + allow/prohibit lists, invite-token sharing, public invite lookup, accept/regenerate, PUT /campaigns, BESM Extras reference, Resend forgot-password stub). 71/72 pytest cases pass (98.6%). All 54 iteration-3 regressions still green. All 17 new iteration-4 tests pass. The single failing test (TestCORS::test_preflight_preview_origin_ok) is a carry-over from iteration 3 with an unchanged root cause (FRONTEND_URL='*' in backend/.env makes Starlette echo '*' instead of the specific origin). Not a new regression.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iteration 3: when FRONTEND_URL='*' (current .env), allow_origins=['*'] short-circuits the allow_origin_regex, so preflight for preview.emergentagent.com returns '*' instead of the specific origin. No new bug — same RCA as iteration_3.json.

action_items: (carry-over) Either set FRONTEND_URL to the real preview URL, or change server.py so when FRONTEND_URL='*' we pass allow_origins=[] + allow_origin_regex only. Only needed if cookie-based cross-origin is required — Bearer-token flow works fine as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1280 lines (was 1151) — still well above the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting: auth.py, campaigns.py, invites.py, characters.py, sessions.py, ws.py, genesis.py.
accept_invite (server.py:721) correctly guards 'Table full' but uses HTTPException(400) — per REST convention HTTP 409 Conflict would be more semantic (not blocking).
regenerate_invite (server.py:690) returns 403 when campaign is missing (non-existent cid). Should be 404 for consistency with update_campaign which uses 404→403 order. Minor ordering issue.

update_campaign (PUT /campaigns/{cid}) accepts CampaignIn which has defaults for most fields; a partial update client that omits fields will accidentally reset them to defaults (e.g., max_players back to 6, visibility back to 'public'). Consider a dedicated CampaignPatchIn with Optional[...] fields or use a PATCH endpoint.

forgot_password silently catches nothing — if send_password_reset_email raises (Resend API down), it propagates as 500 and leaks existence. Wrap send in try/except and log; spec says 'does not error'.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestBESMExtras 3 tests, TestCampaignPrimer 4 tests, TestInviteFlow 8 tests, TestForgotPassword 2 tests, plus primer_campaign fixture) — 72 tests total, +17 from iteration 3.
test_credentials: admin@tablegnostic.com/admin123, gm@tablegnostic.com/gm123456, player@tablegnostic.com/player12345 — all confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed campaigns (primer_campaign + 1-seat 'TEST_Full_*' for table-full test + existing fresh_campaign for Genesis + 'TEST_Private_*' for WS 4403) and several disposable users via /auth/register. All campaigns torn down in fixture finalizers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 72 tests across 18 classes. New fixtures: primer_campaign (session-scoped, used by TestCampaignPrimer + TestInviteFlow). New classes: TestBESMExtras, TestCampaignPrimer, TestInviteFlow, TestForgotPassword. Invite flow uses secrets.token_urlsafe(16) → 22-char URL-safe string; test asserts len>=16 for flexibility. Table-full test uses max_players=1 and registers two fresh users. rca of the issue: No new issues in iteration 4. Single carry-over CORS issue RCA already documented in iteration_3.json (FRONTEND_URL='*' overrides regex).
